_comment: Tuning and protocol text for the Hollerau agent. Configuration, not data: rates and wording only. Country cost factors are the rule of thumb in data/package/company.md (Should-cost).

leverage.label: Leverage - Aggressive Protocol
leverage.guidance: Power sits with us: alternatives exist. Anchor low, concede in small steps, trade payment days and volume for price. A credible readiness to switch is allowed; never invent an alternative.

stabilise.label: Strategic - Safeguard Protocol
stabilise.guidance: Long-term partner. Do not squeeze below its sustainable margin: that costs us. Lead with risk-sharing (index clause, payment days, horizon) and cost transparency; keep the tone collaborative.

secure_supply.label: Bottleneck - Protection Protocol
secure_supply.guidance: Supply security first: few or no alternatives. Secure volume, lead time and horizon; pay a fair price, keep the supplier healthy, never threaten to walk.

quality_first.label: Quality Escalation Protocol
quality_first.guidance: The problem is quality and delivery. Get binding ppm commitments and chargebacks per complaint, cite the scorecard and quality notifications; price comes second.

routine.label: Routine - Efficiency Protocol
routine.guidance: Low-touch spend: fewer suppliers, longer frameworks, bundles. Trade contract length and payment days for price; keep it short.

DE.label: Low-Context / Direct Specification
DE.guidance: Formal, concise, data first. No small talk; state the trade-off and the numbers plainly.

AT.label: Low-Context / Formal-Courteous
AT.guidance: Formal and precise with a courteous opening line; data-driven.

CH.label: Low-Context / Precision
CH.guidance: Precise, reliable, understated; emphasise quality, punctuality and long-term reliability.

CZ.label: Mid-Context / Pragmatic
CZ.guidance: Polite and pragmatic; acknowledge the relationship, then concrete figures. Avoid hard ultimatums.

PL.label: Mid-Context / Relationship-Aware
PL.guidance: Respectful and personal; recognise past cooperation before the ask; firm but not confrontational.

HU.label: Mid-Context / Relationship-Aware
HU.guidance: Courteous, relationship-aware; frame the ask as a joint solution.

TR.label: High-Context / Relationship-Preserving
TR.guidance: Warm and respectful; build goodwill, frame concessions as mutual wins, never cause loss of face.

CN.label: High-Context / Harmony-Preserving
CN.guidance: Very polite and patient; long-term partnership framing; avoid direct rejection - offer alternatives instead.

leverage._comment: strong_factors_plus.txt: position from our alternative vs C_open. Factors scale the anchor depth; all 1.0 = off. Switched off after the factors run (neutral result, P18 -0.07); the position stays visible as information.

guidance.strong: Our alternative is cheaper than the cheapest opening offer.
guidance.balanced: Our alternative sits close to the opening offers.
guidance.vulnerable: Our alternative is far dearer than the opening offers, or there is none.

swaps._comment: v3_improvements.txt: trade a lever the supplier wants for a price cut >= premium x our break-even (or the default ask). enabled=false switches the engine off.

floor_pacing._comment: leverage_fix.txt: non-relationship cases anchor at the calibrated C_best estimate (config/calibration.json, from `python -m hollerau.calibrate`) and concede a share of the envelope (C_open - C_best_est) per step: [our message number up to, share]. enabled=false = previous curve.

alternatives._comment: Propose a supplier's own alternative sheet back when it is cheaper for us than the main sheet by at least this (EUR / % of C).

pacing._comment: v3: hold the anchor until this share of the case, then slide to the landing. 0 = old smooth curve.
